subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] mm: add anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list

2026-10-23.patch_summary: This patch adds anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list, allowing them to be split and reclaimed when under memory pressure. This is necessary because without this change, fully mapped mTHP folios that are mostly zero-filled would not get split by the deferred split shrinker, leading to memory regressions. The patch mirrors the existing behavior for PMD-sized folios and only queues mTHP folios of at least 2M for underused splitting. This is a conservative approach to minimize overhead on the common order-0 fault path.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that thp_underused_split_page starts counting mTHP splits, but this creates inconsistencies in the split counter as it can be larger than thp_split_page and per-order stats do not distinguish between underused and other splits. The reviewer suggested making thp_underused_split_page PMD-only with a separate per-order counter for underused splits.
reviews.raw_body:
With this, thp_underused_split_page starts counting mTHP splits.
thp_split_page and thp_deferred_split_page count PMD-sized folios only,
and mTHPs get per-order stats instead. thp_underused_split_page can now
be larger than thp_split_page, and the per-order split counter does not
tell underused splits from the rest.

Should thp_underused_split_page stay PMD-only, with a per-order counter
for underused splits?

This is messy. I am not sure excluding non-PMD splits from the counter
is the right call, but it seems to be the most consistent solution.

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

reviews.author: Joanne Koong (author)
reviews.summary:
Author acknowledged that the current implementation of deferred split shrinker is not suitable for mTHP folios and agreed to restructure in v2, but did not provide any specific details on how it will be addressed.

Author agrees to modify the patch in v4 to handle anonymous mTHP folios consistently with thp_split_page and thp_deferred_split_page, acknowledging that a fix is needed.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Kiryl,

Thanks for taking a look at this patch.

---

This is a great point. Your suggestion makes sense to me, to keep it
consistent with how we handle thp_split_page and
thp_deferred_split_page.
I'll make this change for v4, unless anyone else thinks there is a
cleaner way of accounting this.

Thanks,
Joanne

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch adds anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list, allowing them to be split and reclaimed when under memory pressure. This addresses a problem where fully mapped mTHP folios that are mostly zero-filled were not being split due to their size. The patch introduces a minimum size of 2M for mTHP folios to be considered for splitting, which can be adjusted later if needed. It also maintains backwards compatibility by exempting PMD-sized folios from this minimum size. The change is made in the fault path and khugepaged mTHP collapse path, with minimal overhead on the common order-0 fault path.
